name: AlsSocialDance
description:
I've always wondered why at weddings, a lot of attendees preferred to sit down rather than dance. Initially I thought this was due to a preference to not want to dance - but then those same “sitting attendees” would get up and dance with their friends in a group. Odd!!

Only later did I realize that although women are willing to dance, they lack the confidence to ask a random stranger (whom they have seen dancing on the floor) but are willing to dance *if* someone asked them. Men on the other hand lack confidence in their ability of dancing and that they don’t know enough steps.

Progress- little by little - adds up and before you know it, you’ve got quite a few steps in your bag of tricks.
